about: The one source of 'why' and 'how long' for setup. The install script and the setup guide both read this file.

install.title: Claude Code's command line
install.why: Installing Claude Code's command line so your team can be installed and updated reliably.

install.title: Git
install.why: Installing Git so your team can tell exactly what changed in your project.
install.why_windows: Installing Git because you're on Windows: it gives your team the command line its safety checks run in.

install.title: uv
install.why: Installing uv, a small tool that fetches the right Python for your team without touching the one your computer came with.

install.title: Python
install.why: Installing Python so your team's memory and safety checks can run.

install.title: jq
install.why: Installing jq so your team's guardrails can read what's happening in a session.

install.title: Internet check
install.why: Checking that this computer can reach GitHub, where your team is downloaded from.

install.title: Your project folder
install.why: Creating a folder just for this project, so your team's files stay in one place and your other folders stay as they are.

install.title: Instructions already here
install.why: Checking for instructions you already wrote for Claude here, so nothing of yours gets replaced.

install.title: Nova Caelum's plugin catalog
install.why: Adding Nova Caelum's plugin catalog so Claude Code knows where your team comes from.

install.title: Your team
install.why: Installing your team, and Hyperspace Engine with it.

install.title: Hyperspace Engine's workspace
install.why: Building Hyperspace Engine's private workspace, where your task graph and its checks run.

install.title: Obsidian check
install.why: Checking whether Obsidian is installed, so setup can offer it without asking you to look.
